title: Bridge row -- one bridge candidate's eight declaration rows (NFRA_C3MATERIALIZE L3 wave 1)
description: One SHARD = one bridge candidate carrying the eight declaration rows at the rectangle's own grain (bridge_candidate x declaration_row). DERIVED, NOT TYPED: every typed field's enum is copied at build time from the certified rectangle's own value_domain (workflows/atom_decomposition/runs/nfra-c3materialize-L3/20260828T2240Z/rectangle.final.certified.json @ f430acc99f) and the card_keys Rule-24 record is copied verbatim from its x_rule24; the builder prints the copy beside the source so it is auditable. THE SCHEMA IS A CONTROL, NOT A CONTAINER: the four rules the task order states in prose -- the sequence gate, the FUNCTION tautology guard, the firm-carry refusal, and the owner-less gap -- are made machine-refusable here, because a rule that lives only in prose and a reader's discipline drifts to unenforced (measured on this very project 2026-08-28: the key-expression 'inferred' prohibition was obeyed by every lane and enforced by nothing). Wave 1 declares; it does not fuse and it does not instrument a producing store.

card_keys.domain: how many of a bridge row's TWO endpoint key spaces have a v3 substrate card whose trust.key.key_expression is non-null (basis measured or held; inferred is refused at the v3.1 cut; absent counts as NOT carded)
card_keys.intent: let the certifier REFUSE a join_evidence that cites no declared key -- condition 2 now that the cards carry keys (framing sec 2 row 4)
card_keys.mece: 0 / 1 / 2 carded endpoints partition the measured cases; UNMEASURED covers the not-yet-run member
card_keys.state_coherence: UNMEASURED -> a value moves on the cell's run; NO/ONE -> BOTH moves ONLY when a card owner fills a key (a DIFFERENT owner and TO); no wave-1 act moves it
card_keys.token_census: derived at build: cards / declared key_expression by owner, printed on census_at_build

'inferred' means it is recoverable only by parsing an id string -- which is what L1 measured for 3 of 4 roll-ups; INFERRED IS NOT A FAILING GRADE for a bridge row, it is the honest value for a convention that lives inside an id, and mislabelling it 'measured' is the defect. row_card_keys.description: TYPED: BOTH_ENDPOINTS_CARDED | ONE_ENDPOINT_CARDED | NO_ENDPOINT_CARDED | UNMEASURED. For each endpoint, resolve part_id -> v3 card (by the registry's admitted population, never by glob) -> trust.key.key_expression non-null with basis measured|held. row_firm_carry.description: CVO condition 3, the firm-carry bar (75005). TYPED: CARRIED | NOT_CARRIED | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNMEASURED. Any bridge touching a symbol space must show the firm CARRIED THROUGH the relation, or it is the bd/inf/mdpf identity merge arriving through the registry door. NOT_APPLICABLE is legal ONLY for a bridge with no symbol endpoint and must be justified in evidence; on a symbol-space subject it is a refusal. NEVER guess it from the subject's name. This row is PRD sec 6.3's INPUT (wave 2's output can only be tested against firm boundaries the registry carried through); it does not discharge 6.3.

row_declarability.description: CVO condition 4. TYPED: DECLARABLE_IN_D11_REGISTRY | NAMED_GAP_STORE_OWNER | UNDETERMINED. Can this bridge be DECLARED in a D11-owned registry with no change to any producing store? If it needs the store to start emitting an edge, it is a NAMED GAP for that store's owner and NAMING IT IS THE DELIVERABLE -- condition 4 keeps that work outside D11. Name the OWNER when you name the gap; a gap without an owner is a wish.
